title: The Distribution and Excitation of CH<SUB>3</SUB>CN in a Solar Nebula Analog
question: What are the distribution, column density and excitation of CH3CN in the TW Hya disk, and do disk chemistry models imply in situ formation sufficient to explain it and cometary abundances?

what.value: TW Hya density and temperature structure constrained by SED and HD

evidence.quote: The assumed density and temperature structures, constrained by the TW Hya SED and previous HD observations (cite: Bergin_2013) in (cite: Cleeves_2015)

what.value: Inclination 7 deg and PA 155 deg for deprojection

evidence.quote: using an inclination of 7$\degree$ and PA of 155$\degree$ (cite: Qi_2004; Andrews_2012; Andrews_2016)

what.value: Spectral line data and rotational constants from SLAIM

evidence.quote: Values for these rotational constants and all other spectral line data were taken from the Spectral Line Atlas of Interstellar Molecules (SLAIM)

recipe.method: C18O cube used as filter on CH3CN spectral windows with VISIBLE
Image each line, Keplerian mask convolved with beam (105 AU) to extract spectra, integrate 2.1-3.7 km/s, bootstrap uncertainty
LTE rotational diagram with optical depth correction, likelihood fit by MCMC
assumptions: LTE excitation; solid angle of beam-convolved Keplerian mask

recipe.method: Run model with/without grain-surface reactions, RADMC-3D radiative transfer, simulate ALMA with vis_sample, repeat rotational diagram analysis
assumptions: Distance 59.5 pc, PA 155 deg, inclination 8 deg, M*=0.8 Msun

evidence.quote: disk-averaged column density of N$_T$=1.45$^{+0.19}_{-0.15}\times10^{12}$ cm$^{-2}$
The observed N$_T$ profile decreases with radius from 5 to 0.9$\times10^{12}$ cm$^{-2}$.
N$_T$=1.49$\times$10$^{12}$ cm$^{-2}$ and rotational temperature of T$_{rot}$=36.6 K

not_stated_but_needed: Image size, cell size, clean threshold and masks
Assumed linewidth Δv in rotational diagram
Chemical model code and inputs not public; full network not given
Whether pipeline calibration or manual scripts used
missing_for_reproduction: Chemical model code and exact setup
score_reason: Data and recipe mostly described and public tools used, but chemical model and several imaging details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, rotational diagram analysis numeric and well specified, though model comparison is hard to redo.
